basics.name: Woosang Park, Ph.D.

Solving an optimization problem to minimize maneuver detection lag, providing sufficient time for decision making in SDA operations

projects.name: Space-Watch: Space-domain Wide Area Tracking and Characterization
projects.description: DARPA. Multi-hypothesis target tracking from star-tracker optical measurements using the Randomized Finite Statistical Sets (R-FISST II) framework.
highlights: Initialized target probability distributions via the geometrical probabilistic admissible region (G-PAR) algorithm
Selected top hypotheses associating targets and observations by smart sampling Markov chain Monte Carlo (SSMCMC)
Recursively updated target states with associated observations using a particle Gaussian mixture (PGM) filter

projects.name: New Approaches to Space Domain Awareness in Cislunar Space
highlights: Analyzed dynamic nonlinearity of various orbital element sets by numerical and analytical methods
Derived the analytic osculating-to-mean orbital element transformation using Lie transformation
Developed a semi-analytic orbit maneuver detection algorithm based on Mahalanobis distance for two-body motion
Evaluated the effects of dynamic model fidelity on covariance-based track association performance
Investigated non-gravitational perturbations including JB2008 atmospheric drag, solar radiation pressure, and third-body gravity via JPL DE440 ephemeris

Analyzed nonlinear uncertainty propagation using Gaussian mixture models and Monte Carlo simulation for cislunar orbits in synodic and local action-angle elements from the Birkhoff-Gustavson normal form

projects.name: Development and Verification of Robust Crater Matching Algorithm
highlights: Proposed a crater triangle matching algorithm using projective-permutation invariant descriptors
Assessed robustness against detection noise, false positives, high camera tilt angles, and low pointing accuracy
Verified matching success rates on rendered lunar surface images at high tilt angles
Estimated absolute spacecraft attitude and position using the EPnP algorithm

projects.name: Ground Verification Platform of Lunar Landing Navigation (ALHAT and TRN)
highlights: Designed a 10-DOF IMU Kalman filter for crater-matching based lunar landing navigation simulations
Developed a crater matching algorithm based on conic-pair invariants for the powered descent phase
Verified matching performance in ground tests eliminating IMU drift errors

projects.name: Research on Small Satellite Development - 3U CubeSat
highlights: Analyzed power budgets for given mission durations and payload operations
Led registration of satellite operating frequencies, ensuring compliance and communication coordination

projects.name: Untrackable Debris Active Removal using a Nano Satellite
highlights: Proposed a new concept to accelerate decay of untrackable space debris by physical collision
Performed numerical simulations decelerating debris orbital speed using a windmill-shaped satellite driven by CMG
